rendering_contract.sampling: Canonical4x unchanged; native2x preview uses ordered font+shadow coverage integration. Original PIC2 underlay is constant in every2x2canonicalgroup, so numerical2xBOX changes only authored text coverage; no filtered backdrop. Actual generalized shadow replay is a future engineer-reviewed context gate.
rendering_contract.unsupported: Missing/extended/absent runs classic; no game-wide replacement.

compatibility.serialization: 60 concatenated width,height,size unsignedLE16 + original RLE, no count/presence; metrics60(width,height,width+1)u16. Source hashes only, no encoded originals distributed.
